name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_feudal

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_house
text: ʻŌLELO AKONA: hāʻawi kahi hale i wahi no ka poʻe ʻē aʻe 5. E nānā i ka helu kanaka ma ka sidebar a kūkulu i nā hale ma mua o ka piha ʻana.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_militia
text: ʻŌLELO AKONA: hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻonoho i ka pūʻali a hiki i 15 i loko o kahi hale ke loaʻa ka waiwai.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_raid
text: ʻŌLELO AKONA: ma AoE2 ke kani o ke kūlanakauhale e hoʻouna i nā kānaka mahiʻai i ka town center. E kani ia ke hoʻouka ka ʻenemi i kāu kūlanakauhale.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_select
text: ʻŌLELO AKONA: ʻo ka laina Idle ma ka sidebar ma ka ʻaoʻao ʻākau e helu ana i nā kānaka mahiʻai noho ʻole. E hāʻawi iā lākou i ka hana.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_villager
text: ʻŌLELO AKONA: e aʻo mau i nā kānaka mahiʻai i nā au mua. ʻOi aku ka waiwai o ka nui o nā kānaka mahiʻai.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_wood
text: ʻŌLELO AKONA: hōʻiliʻili wikiwiki nā kānaka mahiʻai kokoke i ka hale lawe. E kūkulu i kahi ʻoki lāʻau ma ka pili o nā lāʻau.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.villager
text: E aʻo i kekahi kanaka mahiʻai: pāwehe ʻakau ma kāu town center a koho i ka villager. Hōʻike ka sidebar ma ka ʻaoʻao ʻākau i ka ʻai āna e koi ai.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.wood
text: E hōʻiliʻili i ka lāʻau 50: koho i kekahi kanaka mahiʻai a pāwehe ʻakau i kahi lāʻau. Hōʻike ka sidebar ma ka ʻaoʻao ʻākau i kāu lāʻau.

name: aoe2mc.wonder.built
text: Ua kūkulu ka mea pāʻani %s i kupanaha.

name: aoe2mc.wonder.destroyed
text: Ua luku ʻia ke kupanaha o ka mea pāʻani %s.
